chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Danny's plan for block dances across the South
summary: Danny planned block parties with separate nights for Black and white audiences in every small town in Louisiana, Arkansas and Texas.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Well, I'm determined, see, because Paul was telling me, 'Maybe you can get the Senator to let you have one of them station wagons, since you advertised for Hadicol(?) so well' or something. So I came over and I brought a whole plan. We will do block dances, send a (?) for the Hadicol Company, we'll charge admission to the block dance in every little country town in Louisiana, Arkansas and Texas...

Yeah, you block off a block and you have what is called a block party. And if it's successful, you can go into auditoriums, you can go in high school auditoriums and municipal auditoriums all over, one night for Colored and one night for White -- because it was prejudiced in them
days, see... It still is, but...
